model.include_dbt_sandbox.kf_ds_int_bios.description: Intermediate table for kf_ds_src_biospecimen. Transforms dataservice entities for better usability and clarity. Excludes certain entites that are not needed.

uuid.name: uuid
uuid.description: A Universally Unique Identifier which is a 128-bit number used to uniquely identify information in Kids First Dataservice. This is automatically generated by Kids First Dataservice. Not actively used in any downstream operations.

specimen_id.name: specimen_id
specimen_id.description: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents a biospecimen. In the format, "BS_XXXXXXXX"

dewrangle_specimen_id.name: dewrangle_specimen_id
dewrangle_specimen_id.description: The dewrangle generated id for a specimen. This id is a lower-cased version of the corresponding kf id, which replaces the pre-fix "BS_" with "bs-".

external_id.name: external_id
external_id.description: External ID or source entity ID used by contributor. In the case of genomic files, this is the full s3 path of a genomic file. Is only unique within a study, not across all studies.

visible.name: visible
visible.description: Flags visbility of a record in Kids First Dataservice. Used in downstream operations to determine if data is eligble to be ingested into FHIR and released to the KF Portal. When set to false, data is not permitted to be released. When set to true, data can be released and used for downstream processes. Set by the data analyst at time of ingest and modified when eligible for release. Only for internal use.

visibility_reason.name: visibility_reason
visibility_reason.description: Gives justification for the value in the visible column from a set of enums. Set by the data analyst at the time of ingest and modified as needed. Only for internal use.

visibility_comment.name: visibility_comment
visibility_comment.description: Additional details for the visbility reason. Typically notes the associated jira ticket number when applicable. Set by the data analyst at the time of ingest and modified as needed. Only for internal use.

external_sample_id.name: external_sample_id
external_sample_id.description: Name given to sample by contributor.

external_aliquot_id.name: external_aliquot_id
external_aliquot_id.description: Name given to aliquot by contributor.

source_text_tissue_type.name: source_text_tissue_type
source_text_tissue_type.description: Description of the kind of biospecimen collected.

composition.name: composition
composition.description: The cellular composition of the biospecimen.

age_at_event_days.name: age_at_event_days
age_at_event_days.description: Age at the time of event occurred in number of days since birth

analyte_type.name: analyte_type
analyte_type.description: The molecular description of the aliquot.

participant_id.name: participant_id
participant_id.description: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents a participant. In the format, "PT_XXXXXXXX"

sequencing_center_id.name: sequencing_center_id
sequencing_center_id.description: The kf_id of the sequencing center.

method_of_sample_procurement.name: method_of_sample_procurement
method_of_sample_procurement.description: The method used to procure the sample used to extract analyte(s).

sample_id.name: sample_id
sample_id.description: The kf_id of the sample this specimen comes from.

specimen_status.name: specimen_status
specimen_status.description: Whether the specimen is available for further processing in the biorepository.

has_matched_normal_sample.name: has_matched_normal_sample
has_matched_normal_sample.description: Indicates if the biospecimen has a matched normal sample.

shipment_origin.name: shipment_origin
shipment_origin.description: The original site of the aliquot.

shipment_date.name: shipment_date
shipment_date.description: The date the aliquot was shipped.

uberon_id_anatomical_site.name: uberon_id_anatomical_site
uberon_id_anatomical_site.description: The ID of the term from Uber-anatomy ontology which represents harmonized anatomical ontologies.

ncit_id_tissue_type.name: ncit_id_tissue_type
ncit_id_tissue_type.description: The ID term from the National CancerInstitute Thesaurus which represents a harmonized tissue_type.

ncit_id_anatomical_site.name: ncit_id_anatomical_site
ncit_id_anatomical_site.description: The ID term from the NationalCancer Institute Thesaurus which represents a harmonized anatomical_site.

spatial_descriptor.name: spatial_descriptor
spatial_descriptor.description: Ontology term that harmonizes thespatial concepts from Biological Spatial Ontology.

preservation_method.name: preservation_method
preservation_method.description: Text term that represents the method used to preserve the sample.

amount_units.name: amount_units
amount_units.description: The units of the amount of the aliquot.

cell_entity.name: cell_entity
cell_entity.description: The type of single cell entity.

data_category.name: data_category
data_category.description: Inidicates the broad category of the type of data file.

workflow_type.name: workflow_type
workflow_type.description: Denotes the generic name for the workflow utilized in analysis. For source files, this field should be NULL. These values are maintained by the bioinformatics team.

workflow_version.name: workflow_version
workflow_version.description: Indicates the major version of the workflow. For source files, this field should be NULL. These values are maintained by the bioinformatics team.

workflow_endpoint.name: workflow_endpoint
workflow_endpoint.description: The endpoint name of the task outputs from CAVATICA task or the CAVATICA app output name. These values are maintained by the bioinformatics team.

file_version_descriptor.name: file_version_descriptor
file_version_descriptor.description: Denotes whether a file is unharmonized, a previous verison or the latest version.

cavatica_file_id.name: cavatica_file_id
cavatica_file_id.description: Indicates the file ID in CAVATICA. Populated and maintained by the Kids First bioinformatics team.

cavatica_volume.name: cavatica_volume
cavatica_volume.description: Indicates the CAVATICA volume ID, mediating cloud storage access. Popualted and maintained by the Kids First bioinformatics team.

data_category.name: data_category
data_category.description: Inidicates the broad category of the type of data file.

workflow_tool.name: workflow_tool
workflow_tool.description: Specifies the specific tool within the workflow used to generate the file. For source files, this field should be NULL. These values are maintained by the bioinformatics team.

workflow_type.name: workflow_type
workflow_type.description: Denotes the generic name for the workflow utilized in analysis. For source files, this field should be NULL. These values are maintained by the bioinformatics team.

workflow_version.name: workflow_version
workflow_version.description: Indicates the major version of the workflow. For source files, this field should be NULL. These values are maintained by the bioinformatics team.

workflow_endpoint.name: workflow_endpoint

file_version_descriptor.name: file_version_descriptor

cavatica_file_id.name: cavatica_file_id
cavatica_file_id.description: Indicates the file ID in CAVATICA. Populated and maintained by the Kids First bioinformatics team.

cavatica_volume.name: cavatica_volume

uuid.name: uuid

dewrangle_study_id.name: dewrangle_study_id

visible.name: visible
visible.description: Flags visbility of a record in Kids First Dataservice. Used in downstream operations to determine if data is eligble to be ingested into FHIR and released to the KF Portal. Set by the data analyst at time of ingest and modified when eligible for release. Only for internal use.

visibility_reason.name: visibility_reason

macro.dbt_postgres.postgres__get_relatio.macro_sql:
{% macro postgres__get_relations() -%}

  {#
      -- in pg_depend, objid is the dependent, refobjid is the referenced object
      --  > a pg_depend entry indicates that the referenced object cannot be
      --  > dropped without also dropping the dependent object.
  #}

  {%- call statement('relations', fetch_result=True) -%}
    select distinct
        dependent_namespace.nspname as dependent_schema,
        dependent_class.relname as dependent_name,
        referenced_namespace.nspname as referenced_schema,
        referenced_class.relname as referenced_name

    -- Query for views: views are entries in pg_class with an entry in pg_rewrite, but we avoid
    -- a seq scan on pg_rewrite by leveraging the fact there is an "internal" row in pg_depend for
    -- the view...
    from pg_class as dependent_class
    join pg_namespace as dependent_namespace on dependent_namespace.oid = dependent_class.relnamespace
    join pg_depend as dependent_depend on dependent_depend.refobjid = dependent_class.oid
        and dependent_depend.classid = 'pg_rewrite'::regclass
        and dependent_depend.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass
        and dependent_depend.deptype = 'i'

    -- ... and via pg_depend (that has a row per column, hence the need for "distinct" above, and
    -- making sure to exclude the internal row to avoid a view appearing to depend on itself)...
    join pg_depend as joining_depend on joining_depend.objid = dependent_depend.objid
        and joining_depend.classid = 'pg_rewrite'::regclass
        and joining_depend.refclassid = 'pg_class'::regclass
        and joining_depend.refobjid != dependent_depend.refobjid

    -- ... we can find the tables they query from in pg_class, but excluding system tables. Note we
    -- don't need need to exclude _dependent_ system tables, because they only query from other
    -- system tables, and so are automatically excluded by excluding _referenced_ system tables
    join pg_class as referenced_class on referenced_class.oid = joining_depend.refobjid
    join pg_namespace as referenced_namespace on referenced_namespace.oid = referenced_class.relnamespace
        and referenced_namespace.nspname != 'information_schema'
        and referenced_namespace.nspname not like 'pg\_%'

    order by
        dependent_schema, dependent_name, referenced_schema, referenced_name;

  {%- endcall -%}

  {{ return(load_result('relations').table) }}
{% endmacro %}

macro.dbt_postgres.postgres__get_show_in.macro_sql:
{% macro postgres__get_show_indexes_sql(relation) %}
    select
        i.relname                                   as name,
        m.amname                                    as method,
        ix.indisunique                              as "unique",
        array_to_string(array_agg(a.attname), ',')  as column_names
    from pg_index ix
    join pg_class i
        on i.oid = ix.indexrelid
    join pg_am m
        on m.oid=i.relam
    join pg_class t
        on t.oid = ix.indrelid
    join pg_namespace n
        on n.oid = t.relnamespace
    join pg_attribute a
        on a.attrelid = t.oid
        and a.attnum = ANY(ix.indkey)
    where t.relname = '{{ relation.identifier }}'
      and n.nspname = '{{ relation.schema }}'
      and t.relkind in ('r', 'm')
    group by 1, 2, 3
    order by 1, 2, 3
{% endmacro %}

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.chicoine_down_sy.name: chicoine_down_syndrome_extract_unspecified_blephari_a0d3cad2

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.kf_id.name: kf_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.kf_id.block_contents: Unique id automatically assigned by the Kid's First DRC.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.uuid.name: uuid
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.uuid.block_contents: A Universally Unique Identifier which is a 128-bit number used to uniquely identify information in Kids First Dataservice. This is automatically generated by Kids First Dataservice. Not actively used in any downstream operations.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.visible.name: visible
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.visible.block_contents: Flags visbility of a record in Kids First Dataservice. Used in downstream operations to determine if data is eligble to be ingested into FHIR and released to the KF Portal. When set to false, data is not permitted to be released. When set to true, data can be released and used for downstream processes. Set by the data analyst at time of ingest and modified when eligible for release. Only for internal use.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.visibility_reaso.name: visibility_reason
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.visibility_reaso.block_contents: Gives justification for the value in the visible column from a set of enums. Set by the data analyst at the time of ingest and modified as needed. Only for internal use.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.visibility_comme.name: visibility_comment
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.visibility_comme.block_contents: Additional details for the visbility reason. Typically notes the associated jira ticket number when applicable. Set by the data analyst at the time of ingest and modified as needed. Only for internal use.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.external_id.name: external_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.external_id.block_contents: External ID or source entity ID used by contributor. In the case of genomic files, this is the full s3 path of a genomic file. Is only unique within a study, not across all studies.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.study_id.name: study_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.study_id.block_contents: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents which study a participant, specimen, or genomic file are associated with. In the format, "SD_XXXXXXXX"

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.investigator_id.name: investigator_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.investigator_id.block_contents: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents the Principle Investigator of one study. In the format, "IG_XXXXXXXX"

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.participant_id.name: participant_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.participant_id.block_contents: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents a participant. In the format, "PT_XXXXXXXX"

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.family_id.name: family_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.family_id.block_contents: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents a family. In the format, "FM_XXXXXXXX"

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.specimen_id.name: specimen_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.specimen_id.block_contents: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents a biospecimen. In the format, "BS_XXXXXXXX"

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.genomic_file_id.name: genomic_file_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.genomic_file_id.block_contents: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents a genomic file. In the format, "GF_XXXXXXXX"

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.sequencing_exper.name: sequencing_experiment_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.sequencing_exper.block_contents: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents a sequencing experiment. In the format, "SE_XXXXXXXX"

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.bsgf_id.name: bsgf_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.bsgf_id.block_contents: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents the linkage between a specimen and a file. In the format, "BG_XXXXXXXX"

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.segf_id.name: segf_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.segf_id.block_contents: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents the linkage between a genomic file and a sequencing experiment. In the format, "SG_XXXXXXXX"

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.diagnosis_id.name: diagnosis_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.diagnosis_id.block_contents: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents a diagnosis. In the format, "DG_XXXXXXXX"

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.phenotype_id.name: phenotype_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.phenotype_id.block_contents: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents a phenotype. In the format, "PH_XXXXXXXX"

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.age_at_event_day.name: age_at_event_days
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.age_at_event_day.block_contents: Age at the time of event occurred in number of days since birth

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.name.name: name
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.name.block_contents: For investigator tables: the full name of the investigator. For study tables: the title of the study.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.dewrangle_diagno.name: dewrangle_diagnosis_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.dewrangle_diagno.block_contents: The dewrangle generated id for a diagnosis. This id is a lower-cased version of the corresponding kf id, which replaces the pre-fix "DG_" with "cn-".

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.source_text_diag.name: source_text_diagnosis
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.source_text_diag.block_contents: The pathological diagnosis. Is typically the original diagnosis text received from the data contributors in clinical data submissions. For Kids First Datasets, is typically harmonized to match the text associated to the MONDO ID term.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.mondo_id_diagnos.name: mondo_id_diagnosis
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.mondo_id_diagnos.block_contents: The ID of the term from the Monary Disease Ontology which represents a harmonized diagnosis. This ID is either provided to the Kids First DRC by the contributor or is selected by the Kids First DRC during curation of condition data.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.icd_id_diagnosis.name: icd_id_diagnosis
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.icd_id_diagnosis.block_contents: The ID of the term from the International Classification of Diseases which represents harmonized diagnosis. Not actively populated.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.diagnosis_catego.name: diagnosis_category
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.diagnosis_catego.block_contents: High level diagnosis categorization. Not actively populated.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.source_text_tumo.name: source_text_tumor_location
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.source_text_tumo.block_contents: Only applicable for cancer studies. Represents the location of the tumor.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.uberon_id_tumor_.name: uberon_id_tumor_location
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.uberon_id_tumor_.block_contents: The ID of the term from Uber anatomy ontology which represents harmonized anatomical ontologies. Not actively populated.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.dewrangle_family.name: dewrangle_family_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.dewrangle_family.block_contents: The dewrangle generated id for a family. This id is a lower-cased version of the corresponding kf id.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.family_type.name: family_type
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.family_type.block_contents: Denotes type of family using a set of enums, such as proband only or trio. Not currently populated in Kids First dataservie, but is calculcated by the portal etl and displayed on the Kids First portal.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.participant1_id.name: participant1_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.participant1_id.block_contents: The kf id of one person in the family relationship.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.participant2_id.name: participant2_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.participant2_id.block_contents: The kf id of the second person in the family relationship.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.participant1_to_.name: participant1_to_participant2_relation
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.participant1_to_.block_contents: A descriptor that indicates person 1's genetic relationship to person 2. Is typically mother, father, child, or sibling.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.participant2_to_.name: participant2_to_participant1_relation
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.participant2_to_.block_contents: A descriptor that indicates person 2's genetic relationship to person 1. Is typically null, mother, father, son/daughter, brother/sister.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.relationship_id.name: relationship_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.relationship_id.block_contents: The Kids First assigned kf id that represents a genetic relationship between two participants. In the format, "FR_XXXXXXXX"

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.source_text_note.name: source_text_notes
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.source_text_note.block_contents: Additional text notes from source describing the relationship. Not typically populated.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.dewrangle_genomi.name: dewrangle_genomic_file_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.dewrangle_genomi.block_contents: The dewrangle generated id for a genomic file. This id is a lower-cased version of the corresponding kf id, which replaces the pre-fix "GF_" with "dr-".

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.is_harmonized.name: is_harmonized
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.is_harmonized.block_contents: Denotes whether a genomic file is harmonized to standard outputs or if it is a raw unharmonized genomic file. When set to true, the file is harmonized. When set to false, the file is unharmonized.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.reference_genome.name: reference_genome
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.reference_genome.block_contents: Original reference genome of the unharmonized genomic files. Obtained from the sequencing center.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.controlled_acces.name: controlled_access
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.controlled_acces.block_contents: Denotes whether a file is controlled or open access. When set to true, a file is controlled access and must have a corresponding controlled access acl/authz value. When set to false, a file is open access and must have the open access acl/authz value. All raw source files are by default controlled access. Harmonized genomic outputs controlled access may vary and are determined using a standard mapping file maintained by the bioinformatics team.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.availability.name: availability
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.availability.block_contents: Indicates whether a file is available for immediate download, or is in cold storage. This value is obtained directly from AWS.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.paired_end.name: paired_end
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.paired_end.block_contents: The direction of the read. Not applicable for every file type.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.data_type.name: data_type
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.data_type.block_contents: A more specific denotation of the type of genomic file.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.data_category.name: data_category
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.data_category.block_contents: Inidicates the broad category of the type of data file.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.workflow_tool.name: workflow_tool
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.workflow_tool.block_contents: Specifies the specific tool within the workflow used to generate the file. For source files, this field should be NULL. These values are maintained by the bioinformatics team.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.workflow_type.name: workflow_type
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.workflow_type.block_contents: Denotes the generic name for the workflow utilized in analysis. For source files, this field should be NULL. These values are maintained by the bioinformatics team.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.workflow_version.name: workflow_version
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.workflow_version.block_contents: Indicates the major version of the workflow. For source files, this field should be NULL. These values are maintained by the bioinformatics team.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.workflow_endpoin.name: workflow_endpoint
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.workflow_endpoin.block_contents: The endpoint name of the task outputs from CAVATICA task or the CAVATICA app output name. These values are maintained by the bioinformatics team.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.file_version_des.name: file_version_descriptor
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.file_version_des.block_contents: Denotes whether a file is unharmonized, a previous verison or the latest version.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.cavatica_file_id.name: cavatica_file_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.cavatica_file_id.block_contents: Indicates the file ID in CAVATICA. Populated and maintained by the Kids First bioinformatics team.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.cavatica_volume.name: cavatica_volume
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.cavatica_volume.block_contents: Indicates the CAVATICA volume ID, mediating cloud storage access. Popualted and maintained by the Kids First bioinformatics team.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.dewrangle_invest.name: dewrangle_investigator_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.dewrangle_invest.block_contents: The dewrangle generated id for an investigator. This id is a lower-cased version of the corresponding kf id.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.institution.name: institution
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.institution.block_contents: The name of the investigator's institution.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.vital_status.name: vital_status
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.vital_status.block_contents: The patient's reported state of being alive or deceased.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.disease_related.name: disease_related
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.disease_related.block_contents: A yes or no field indicating whether a patient's deceased vital status is a result of the disease.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.dewrangle_partic.name: dewrangle_participant_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.dewrangle_partic.block_contents: The dewrangle generated id for a participant. This id is a lower-cased version of the corresponding kf id, which replaces the pre-fix "PT_" with "pt-".

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.is_proband.name: is_proband
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.is_proband.block_contents: Denotes whether participant is proband of study. When set to true, the participant is the proband of their family. When set to false, the participant is not the proband of their family.There are no restrictions on number of probands. A family can have zero or as many probands as designated by the Principle Investigator in the original clinical data submission.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.gender.name: gender
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.gender.block_contents: The genetic sex of the participant

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.affected_status.name: affected_status
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.affected_status.block_contents: Denotes whether a participant is affected by the disease or cancer focus of the study. When set to true, a participant has the disease/cancer. When set to false, a participant does not have the disease/cancer. Participants that have this value set to true, should have a correspnding condition record in the database.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.species.name: species
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.species.block_contents: The species of the research particpant

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.dewrangle_phenot.name: dewrangle_phenotype_id
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.dewrangle_phenot.block_contents: The dewrangle generated id for a phenotype. This id is a lower-cased version of the corresponding kf id, which replaces the pre-fix "PH_" with "cn-".

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.source_text_phen.name: source_text_phenotype
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.source_text_phen.block_contents: Name given to phenotype by contributor. Is typically the original phenotype text received from the data contributors in clinical data submissions. For Kids First Datasets, is typically harmonized to match the text associated to the HPO ID term.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.hpo_id_phenotype.name: hpo_id_phenotype
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.hpo_id_phenotype.block_contents: The ID of the term from Human Phenotype Ontology which represents a harmonized phenotype. This ID is either provided to the Kids First DRC by the contributor or is selected by the Kids First DRC during curation of condition data.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.observed.name: observed
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.observed.block_contents: Denotes whether a phenotype is negative or positive

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.snomed_id_phenot.name: snomed_id_phenotype
doc.include_dbt_sandbox.snomed_id_phenot.block_contents: The ID of the term from Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine --Clinical Terms which encodes clinical terminology. Not actively populated.

doc.include_dbt_sandbox.sample_event_key.name: sample_event_key

doc.dbt.__overview__.name: __overview__
doc.dbt.__overview__.block_contents:
### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.

---

- Read the [dbt viewpoint](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/viewpoint)

- Join the [dbt Community](https://www.getdbt.com/community/) for questions and discussion
